speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, could you please tell me how many weeks pregnant you are and when these symptoms first started?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information. Do you have any specific abdominal pain, vaginal bleeding, or decreased fetal movement? Additionally, have you noticed any rash or joint pain?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever. I also have Headache, Anorexia, Fatigue, Malaise.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Given the consumption of ice cream and these systemic symptoms, I am concerned about listeriosis. I will order tests to check for this infection and assess fetal well-being.

REQUEST TEST: Blood_Culture, Listeria_Serology, Fetal_Heart_Tone

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Blood_Culture: Gram-positive rods that are catalase-positive and show distinctive tumbling motility in the liquid medium., Listeria_Serology: NORMAL READINGS, Fetal_Heart_Tone: Fetal heart sounds present.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The blood culture results showing Gram-positive rods with tumbling motility are classic for Listeria monocytogenes, confirming the diagnosis despite normal serology.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeriosis
